concerns.text: Tasks implement and verify FR-010 (feature_importance.traditional/topological arrays, model_metrics.schema.yaml) but spec.md defines only FR-001…FR-009. A task list cannot satisfy a requirement the spec never authorized; either add FR-010 to spec.md (US-2 scenario 3 arguably supports it) or remove the FR-010 tags and schema requirement. Currently the coverage table asserts traceability that does not exist.

T013 retroactively narrows scope to logP-only (N=1) while spec.md's Key Entities/Assumptions and FR-005/SC-003 define three properties (solubility, logP, boiling point). A task that amends the spec mid-execution to match a reduced deliverable is classic retroactive narrowing; the spec amendment must land BEFORE tasks execute against the reduced scope, and the tasks document should not pre-commit to N=1 outputs (T008's fwer_report with a single test) until the spec actually says so.

T009 computes VIF 'only for the Linear Regression model'. FR-007 places no model restriction on VIF diagnostics ('detect and report multicollinearity among predictors'). VIF is computed from the feature matrix, not a model; this is an unexplained narrowing of FR-007's deliverable.

T015 invents a hard acceptance threshold 'MI > 0.1' and fails the pipeline if unmet. SC-001 only makes significance interpretation 'contingent upon' the MI analysis; nothing in spec/plan sets 0.1 as a pass/fail gate. This adds an acceptance criterion the spec never authorized and could abort a valid study for an arbitrary threshold.

T002 fixes σ = 0.1 for persistence images while data-model.md documents kernel_bandwidth default 1.0. Constitution VII requires explicit, consistent parameter documentation; pick one value and align the artifacts.

T008 applies plain Bonferroni (matching FR-005) but plan.md's coverage map specifies 'Holm–Bonferroni'. These are different procedures; the tasks document should note the discrepancy or the plan should be corrected so the implemented correction matches the FR.
